title: Competition: Win a set of Scribe Gravel Ultra wheels worth £999
content:

Competition: Win a set of Scribe Gravel Ultra wheels worth £999

We’re giving you, our loyal readers, the chance to win a set of lightweight Scribe Gravel Ultra Steel Spoke wheels worth £999.

The Gravel Ultra wheels are designed for speed, resilience and real-world performance, weighing just 1,390g, providing support for heavier race and adventure setups and reducing aerodynamic drag and rolling resistance for off-road speed.

With a combination of T1000, T1100, T700 and T900 carbon fibres, Scribe has managed to minimise weight while also improving compliance and keeping structural durability when impacts are unavoidable.

The hooked rims have a 30mm internal width, to provide the choice of adding more stable, wider tyres, and they’re built with Scribe’s ULTRA J-bend hub, with a 45-tooth ratchet drive system and ceramic bearings for maximum efficiency. This pair have been assembled by hand with Alpina Ultralite Aero Stainless Steel spokes to balance strength, responsiveness and light weight.

To be in with a chance of winning, write the answer to the question below in the form before Sunday 25th October 2026.

What is the claimed weight of the Scribe Gravel Ultra Steel Spokes wheelset?

A. 1,390g
B. 1,400g
